subtitle: Lesson 54 · Subqueries, CTEs, and Views

code:
SELECT p1.Name, p1.ListPrice, p1.ProductSubcategoryID
FROM Production.Product AS p1
WHERE p1.ListPrice > (
  SELECT AVG(p2.ListPrice)
  FROM Production.Product AS p2
  WHERE p2.ProductSubcategoryID = p1.ProductSubcategoryID
);
caption: p1.ProductSubcategoryID INSIDE the subquery — that's what makes it correlated.

steps.label: INDEPENDENT
steps.sub: no reference to outer query — runs once

steps.label: CORRELATED
steps.sub: references outer row — runs per row
